-- name: Captain_Bvellos
-- Generated by scripts/quests/velious-simple.mjs; edit server/internal/quest/velious_simple_quests.json.
-- P99: https://wiki.project1999.com/Dire_Wolf-Hide_Cloak_Quest (sha256 5e16e1b412bd929aacf43601b6c98732f0d4cb2854d961a23f4d282533667166)
-- Original: server/internal/quest/upstream/projecteq/kael/Captain_Bvellos.pl (sha256 3b1d6c8b632d82b8a1d19a92a08920c83fd00fb53f22d23232e7bc20a237714d)
-- Reviewed P99 exchanges using existing quest primitives. Quest faction gating remains intentionally bypassed.
-- The missing Sealed Letter -> Dire Wolf-Hide Cloak exchange is restored from P99. Unreviewed bounty branches remain unavailable. XP/faction magnitudes follow neighboring upstream exchanges where P99 gives no number.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Greetings, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ". I am the captain of the Kael militia. I will be watching those of your kind who have come to Kael Drakkel as mercenaries and bounty hunters. You may have come here to serve king Tormax but Kael is my home and I intend to keep it a safe place for the Kromzek. Keep yourself out of trouble or you will end up in a world of pain.")
  elseif e.message:findi("work") then
    e.self:Say("Are you looking for work, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. "? I may have a use for one of your kind. I believe that several nobles in this fine city are not all they appear to be. I have suspicions about that filthy Wenglawks. He will do whatever it takes to amass his own wealth. My sources tell me that he may very well be trading with the Coldain, or worse yet, the dragons. If you could find me proof of his underhanded dealings, I would be most pleased.")
  elseif e.message:findi("proof") then
    e.self:Say("The more convincing the proof is, the better. There must be a record of his actions somewhere.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 1718 }) then
    e.self:Say("This indeed points to Wenglawks being a traitor. If only there were more proof I could take this to the king. Thank you, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ", you have done a great service for Kael. Take this mask as a reward for your service to this city.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25024)
    e.other:Faction(419, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(429, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -90, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(20000)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 1717 }) then
    e.self:Say("This will be that fool's downfall. How dare he trade with our enemies! I am sure King Tormax will have him put to death. Take my cloak. It is the last item I have to give. I must see the king immediately about these matters!")
    e.other:SummonItem(25019)
    e.other:AddEXP(20000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, -30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -90, 0)
  end
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

-- Reviewed P99 exchanges using existing quest primitives. Quest faction gating remains intentionally bypassed.
-- The missing Sealed Letter -> Dire Wolf-Hide Cloak exchange is restored from P99. Bounty branches reviewed against cached P99; head has no XP, paws retain upstream XP; reward odds remain undocumented. XP/faction magnitudes follow neighboring upstream exchanges where P99 gives no number.
local item_lib = require("items")

function event_say(e)
  if e.message:findi("hail") then
    e.self:Say("Greetings, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ". I am the captain of the Kael militia. I will be watching those of your kind who have come to Kael Drakkel as mercenaries and bounty hunters. You may have come here to serve king Tormax but Kael is my home and I intend to keep it a safe place for the Kromzek. Keep yourself out of trouble or you will end up in a world of pain.")
  elseif e.message:findi("work") then
    e.self:Say("Are you looking for work, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. "? I may have a use for one of your kind. I believe that several nobles in this fine city are not all they appear to be. I have suspicions about that filthy Wenglawks. He will do whatever it takes to amass his own wealth. My sources tell me that he may very well be trading with the Coldain, or worse yet, the dragons. If you could find me proof of his underhanded dealings, I would be most pleased.")
  elseif e.message:findi("keep safe") or e.message:findi("keep kael safe") then
    e.self:Say("With the influx of [mercenaries] into Kael Drakkel, I have seen minor crimes increase. I have had to increase my militia patrols. A majority of my militia work longer hours than they did before. There was a time when we only had to watch for the dragons from the sky and the Coldain from the outside. Now we must watch within.")
  elseif e.message:findi("mercenaries") then
    e.self:Say("I have several bounties open if you are interested. Bring me the head of a Coldain and I will reward you with a small sum of money and spread the word of your good work. There is also a bounty upon the nefarious Icepaw kobolds who serve the outcast Velketor. I require four of the paws of those little beasts.")
  elseif e.message:findi("proof") then
    e.self:Say("The more convincing the proof is, the better. There must be a record of his actions somewhere.")
  end
end

function event_trade(e)
  if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 30081 }) then
    e.self:Say("Excellent, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ". Here is the bounty as promised.")
    e.other:GiveCash(0, 0, 0, 8)
    e.other:Faction(448, 40, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 10, 0)
    e.other:Faction(429, 10, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
    -- Cached P99 explicitly says this head turn-in yields no experience.
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 25301, item2 = 25301, item3 = 25301, item4 = 25301 }) then
    e.self:Say("You have done well to hunt down these foul dogs.")
    e.self:Emote("reaches into a large bag and pulls something shiny from within its depths 'Take this as a reward.'")
    -- P99 identifies all three rewards, not odds. Retain upstream ChooseRandom mechanism.
    e.other:SummonItem(eq.ChooseRandom(25077, 25084, 25018))
    e.other:Faction(448, 40, 0)
    e.other:Faction(419, 10, 0)
    e.other:Faction(429, 10, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -20, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(20000) -- P99 documents XP without magnitude; preserved ProjectEQ value.
    e.other:Ding()
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 1718 }) then
    e.self:Say("This indeed points to Wenglawks being a traitor. If only there were more proof I could take this to the king. Thank you, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ", you have done a great service for Kael. Take this mask as a reward for your service to this city.")
    e.other:SummonItem(25024)
    e.other:Faction(419, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(429, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -90, 0)
    e.other:AddEXP(20000)
  elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, { item1 = 1717 }) then
    e.self:Say("This will be that fool's downfall. How dare he trade with our enemies! I am sure King Tormax will have him put to death. Take my cloak. It is the last item I have to give. I must see the king immediately about these matters!")
    e.other:SummonItem(25019)
    e.other:AddEXP(20000)
    e.other:Faction(429, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(448, 30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(436, -30, 0)
    e.other:Faction(430, -90, 0)
  end
  -- Return unrelated and surplus offers on both accepted and rejected trades.
  item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
